images.title: Same units first
images.purpose: Shows that once 4 hours is written as 240 minutes, 150 minutes : 90 km and 240 minutes : 144 km line up on a double number line.
images.composition: A double number line across the middle of the frame with one conversion line above it. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: Top line in teal (#0072B2) with the word 'minutes' at its right end; bottom line in amber (#E69F00) with the word 'km' at its right end; both lines start at a shared left tick labelled '0'. Top line ticks: 150 at 62.5 percent of the length and 240 at the full length. Bottom line ticks: 90 directly below 150 and 144 directly below 240. The 240 and 144 ticks are joined by a short vertical reddish purple (#CC79A7) dashed line. Above the top line, centred, the label '4 hours = 240 minutes'. Exactly 2 lines, 5 ticks.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Change to the same unit before writing the proportion.
images.description: Shows that once 4 hours is written as 240 minutes, 150 minutes : 90 km and 240 minutes : 144 km line up on a double number line.

image_decisions.why: Mixing hours and minutes is the trap; aligning both quantities in one unit shows the proportion working.
